name: Peter Pan
flavor_text: "Come on, you big bully. You've gotta be faster than that!"

name: Belle & Beast
text:
Shift 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Belle or Beast.)
INSPIRING DANCE Whenever this character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.
APPRECIATIVE AUDIENCE 6 {I} — Ready your other characters. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

name: Dash Parr & Violet Parr
text:
Combo Shift 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Dash Parr, one named Violet Parr, or one of each.)
Evasive, Resist +1
INCREDIBLE TACTICS Whenever this character quests or challenges, draw a card for each card under them.

name: Red Moon Ritual
text:
Sing Together 7 (Any number of your or your teammates' characters with total cost 7 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)
Banish chosen character.

name: Red Alert
text: Banish chosen character with 3 {S} or less. If you have a Monster character in play, chosen opponent loses 1 lore.
flavor_text:
"Please remain calm. This is not a drill."
—CDA Agent

name: RAHR!
text: Chosen character gets +3 {S} this turn.
flavor_text:
"Did you see the look on my face? It was the scariest one yet!"
—Mike Wazowski

name: Prophetic Vision
text: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top card. If it's an action card, you may play it for free. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck, then each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
flavor_text: The vision showed the city but not the source of its power.

name: It's Gonna Be Great!
text:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.

name: Scream Canister
text: ERRATIC SCREAMS {E}, 2 {I} — Exert all cards in your inkwell. Exert chosen opposing character with 2 {S} or less.
flavor_text: "'Those screams are unstable, Randall.' Pffft.  Maybe for you, you big hairball."

name: Bunch of Balloons
text:
FLOAT AWAY When you play this item, choose a location of yours. While this item is in play, that location gains Evasive. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge it.)
OUT OF SIGHT 3 {I} — Return this item to your hand.

name: Beast's Castle
text: IMMINENT THREAT Your Floodborn characters gain Rush. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
flavor_text: A deep rumble echoed through the forest as the vine ripped the castle from its foundation.

name: Carl's House
text: MOVING DAY Once during your turn, you may move chosen character from here to another location for free. If you do, gain 1 lore.

name: Launchpad
text: Alert (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavor_text:
Launchpad: "Don't worry, DW, I'll make sure we crash there safely!" 
Darkwing Duck: "That's what I'm afraid of."

name: Dug
text: FETCH! When you play this character, if you have an item in play, draw a card.
flavor_text: "A ball! Oh boy, oh boy, a ball!"

name: Roz
text: ALWAYS Each opponent plays with the top card of their deck faceup.
flavor_text: "And I'm sure you filed your paperwork correctly. For once."

name: Merlin
text:
MINOR TRICKERY When you play this character, you may draw a card from the bottom of your deck.
AGE OF INCONVENIENCE When this character is banished, put this card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

name: Quackerjack
text: EVIL DESIGN When you play this character and whenever he quests, put the top 4 cards of your deck into your discard. You may deal 1 damage to chosen character for each item card put into your discard this way.

name: Belle
text: DREAMING OF MORE You pay 1 {I} less to shift a character on top of this character.
flavor_text: "I just finished the most wonderful story about a beanstalk and an ogre ..."

name: Ellie Fredricksen
text: ALWAYS WITH YOU When this character is banished, you may put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
flavor_text: "Adventure has a way of finding us wherever we go."

name: Mrs. Hasagawa
flavor_text: The old woman turned as the vine's shadow fell over her fruit stand. "Hello, dear! More mangoes today?"

name: Alpha
text: WHO WANTS A TREAT? Whenever you play an item, chosen character gets +1 {S} and gains Resist +1 this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavor_text: "Now we will find the small mailman and The One Who Smells of Prunes."

name: Sulley
text: JUMP SCARE While you have 5 or more cards in your inkwell, this character gets +2 {S}.
flavor_text:
"Show them what it takes to be our top scarer!"
—Henry J. Waternoose III

name: Randall Boggs
text:
GET OUTTA HERE! When you play this character, put chosen character of yours into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
DEVIOUS PLAN At the end of your turn, if all cards in your inkwell are exerted, gain 1 lore.

name: Piglet
flavor_text:
"It's okay, Piglet. Being scared doesn't mean you're not brave. In fact, I think you can only be brave if you're scared first!"
—Christopher Robin, Hunny Sage

name: Mickey Mouse
flavor_text: "Oh boy, I knew climbing this vine would be worth it. There's so much to see up here!"

name: Hades
text: Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
flavor_text: "This little guy is so hideous! I love it! And the way it sucks up flood ink? Even I couldn't have planned it any better."

name: Antonio Madrigal
text: HEALING HANDS When you play this character, you may remove up to 3 damage from chosen character of yours. If you removed damage this way, put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Maid Marian
text: INKFLOW Whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Robin Hood
text: KEEN-EYED Your Floodborn characters gain Alert. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavor_text: The vine created defenders to keep silent watch on the surrounding lands.

name: Boo
text: MAKING MEMORIES While you have 5 or more cards in your inkwell, this character gets +2 {L}.
flavor_text: For the rest of her life, Boo would remember her friend, Kitty.

name: Pluto
text: Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
flavor_text: He didn't like the smell of that vine one bit.

name: Charles Muntz
text:
USEFUL GEAR Whenever you play an item, look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
FIND THAT BIRD! Whenever this character quests, look at the top card of your deck. If it's a character card named Kevin, you may reveal it and put it into your hand to gain 3 lore. Otherwise, put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

name: Henry J. Waternoose III
text: THE BOTTOM LINE While you have more cards in your inkwell than each opposing player, this character gets +2 {L} and gains Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

name: Eeyore
text: HUNNY TACTICS Whenever this character quests, chosen Hunny character of yours gets +1 {L} and gains Ward until the start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
flavor_text: "It's okay. Pile more things on. I'll be fine."

name: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad
text:
Shift 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Darkwing Duck or Launchpad.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
VICTORY POSE During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.

name: Power Surge
text: Each player puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
flavor_text:
Sulley: "What was that?" 
Mike: "I have no idea, but it would be really great if it didn't do it again."

name: Focused Search
text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card named Kevin or an item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: We've Got a Lot to Do!
text:
(A character with cost 3 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Put chosen item or location into its player's inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Startle
text: Chosen character gets -3 {S} this turn.
flavor_text:
"Hey, careful, buddy! That's not me. That's a vine copy of me!"
—Aladdin

name: Closet Door Portal
text:
KNOCK, KNOCK This item enters play exerted.
WHO'S THERE? {E}, 2 {I} — Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character, item, or location card with cost 6 or less and play it for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Hana's Inkcaster
text: REJUVENATING FLOURISH {E} — Remove up to 2 damage from chosen character. If there's a card under that character, they gain Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

name: Laugh Canister
text: COPYCAT {E} — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted. Chosen opponent may put the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Translation Collar
text: YOU ARE MY FRIEND {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gets +1 {L} and gains Support this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
flavor_text: "SQUIRREL!"

name: Big Book of Hunny
text: INVOKE HUNNY {E}, 2 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Hunny card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Hundred Acre Wood
text:
HOME AWAY FROM HOME Characters get +1 {W} while here.
HUNNY QUEST Hunny characters get +1 {L} while here.

name: Violet Parr
text:
Shift 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Violet Parr.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
HEROIC SYNERGY Whenever you play this or another Hero character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

name: Aladdin
text: THE VINE PROVIDES Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
flavor_text:
"Wait, that's not an Aladdin glimmer—that's a vineling replica!" 
—Shanzay, an Illumineer

name: Willie the Giant
text: DEFEND THE STALK Your Floodborn characters gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavor_text: The vine's embrace helped shield its replicas from harm.

name: Sprout
text:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
BOTANICAL EVIL When you play this character, you may choose and discard an Alien character card or a location card from your hand. If you do, deal 2 damage to chosen character.

name: Stitch
flavor_text: "MY frog! It is very important!"

name: Sheriff of Nottingham
text: Challenger +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 {S}.)
flavor_text: "Now, look here, you overgrown weed . . ."

name: Mata
flavor_text: "Three pork combos, extra bacon on the side, two chili cheese samplers, a basket of liver and onion rings, a catch of the day, and a steak cut in the shape of a trout."

name: Violet Parr
text: Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
flavor_text: "Mom? I'm sorry to call you, but um, I think there's a pretty big problem outside the house."

name: Dr. Hamsterviel
text: Alert (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavor_text: "No one can hide from me. From here I can see everything!"

name: Owl
text: HUNNY ALLIANCE While you have another Hunny character in play, this character gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

name: Megavolt
text: FORCE FIELD While you have no cards in your hand, this character gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
flavor_text:
"This guy's a real live wire!"
—Launchpad

name: Darkwing Duck
text: PREEMPTIVE STRIKE When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
flavor_text: "No one messes with Darkwing Duck and gets away with it!"

name: Omnidroid
text: FACTORY SETTINGS While this character has no damage, it gets +2 {S}.
flavor_text:
"All right, let's see who's gonna be facing this bad boy!"
—Syndrome

name: Flynn Rider
text: WE CAN WORK THIS OUT Whenever an opponent chooses this character for an action or ability, they choose and discard a card.

name: The Irate Chef
flavor_text:
"All right, buster, that's it! You want a special order, then you make it!"
—The Irate Chef

name: Kronk
text:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
PICKUP! Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
flavor_text: "You want that extra crispy?"

name: Mulan
text: DEMOLISH Whenever you play this or another Floodborn character, you may banish chosen item.
flavor_text: This replica is just as good in a fight as the original—no training necessary.

name: Diablo
text: FLURRY OF FEATHERS Your characters named Maleficent gain Resist +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavor_text:
"You are the only one I can trust, my pet."
—Maleficent

name: Scar
text:
VICTOR'S REWARD During your turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.
FILL THE RANKS During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, draw a card.

name: Maximus
text: NO ESCAPE If you discarded a card this turn, this character gains Challenger +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)

name: Omnidroid
text:
Shift 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Omnidroid.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
RETURN ON INVESTMENT When you shift this character, you may return all cards under it to your hand.

name: The Vine
text:
Floodborn Shift 7 {I} (You may pay 7 {I} to play this on top of one of your Floodborn characters.)
SATURATE Your other exerted Floodborn characters gain Bodyguard.
HOSTILE SWARM During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, deal 1 damage to each opposing character.

name: Cower Before Me!
text: Up to 2 chosen opposing characters can't challenge during their next turn.

name: We'll Save Our Village
text:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Your characters and locations gain Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

name: Look What You've Done
text: Deal 2 damage to chosen character. During your turn, when you discard this card, you may play it from your discard. (You pay all costs.)

name: You Broke My Smolder
text: Discard your hand. Draw 2 cards.
flavor_text: "You know, this happens a lot more often than you'd think."

name: Attack of the Vine!
text: Your Floodborn characters gain Resist +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)

name: Windstorm
text: Deal 1 damage to each opposing character and location. Then, deal 2 damage to each opposing character with Evasive and each opposing location with Evasive.

name: Discarded Armor
text: FOUND EQUIPMENT {E} — If you discarded a card this turn, chosen character of yours gains Resist +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)

name: The Weedwhacker
text:
FULL POWER {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)
CLEAR-CUT 2 {I}, Banish this item — Banish chosen Vineling character.

name: Absorbing Bloom
text: METAMORPHOSIS {E}, 1 {I} — If a character was banished in a challenge this turn, draw a card.
flavor_text:
"Oh, this is fascinating! How does it do that?"
—Hana, an Illumineer

name: Vine Entrance
text: ROOT OF POWER The first time a Floodborn character moves here each turn, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

name: Jasmine
text: SHARED RESOURCES When you play this character, each player draws a card.
flavor_text: "This looks like a problem, and I've got a solution!"

name: Boo
text: YOU'RE SAFE NOW While you have an exerted character named Sulley in play, this character can't be challenged.
flavor_text:
"Sullivan's cousin's sister's daughter is a real go-getter. Lots of potential."
—Henry J. Waternoose III

name: Meilin Lee
text: RED PANDA POWER When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Red Panda character card or a song card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Heihei
text: BOTANICAL REMEDY Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you may move 1 damage from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
flavor_text: A copy with even less sense than the original.

name: Winnie the Pooh
text: STICK TOGETHER While you have 2 or more other Hunny characters in play, this character gets +2 {L}.
flavor_text: Hunnymancy is a powerful magic, suitable only for the pure of heart.

name: Mrs. Incredible
text: TORRENT Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you pay 1 {I} less for the next character you shift this turn.
flavor_text: The vine's copy took her most valuable possession: her identity.

name: Mother Gothel
text: MUMMY'S BACK During your turn, when you discard this card, you may play this character from your discard. (You pay all costs.)
flavor_text: "Well, I'm glad somebody let me up!"

name: Kevin
text: BACK TO THE NEST Whenever this character quests, put this card on the top of your deck.
flavor_text:
"She has been gathering food for her babies and must get back to them."
—Dug

name: Peter Pan
text: CLEVER TRICK Whenever one of your Floodborn characters is challenged, the challenging player chooses and discards a card.
flavor_text: The replicas the vine created glowed with an infusion of mixed ink.

name: Randall Boggs
text:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
AFTER-HOURS PROJECT While all cards in your inkwell are exerted, this character gets +2 {L}.

name: Sun Yee
text: Temporary Red Panda Shift 2 {I} (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your Red Panda characters. At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this character and return only this card to your hand.)

name: Dash Parr
text: Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
flavor_text: "Hey look, I'm here! No wait, I'm over here now! Nope, back here again!"

name: Henry J. Waternoose III
text: THE BOTTOM LINE While you have more cards in your inkwell than each opposing player, this character gets +2 {L} and gains Ward. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)

name: Roz
text: ALWAYS Each opponent plays with the top card of their deck faceup.
flavor_text: "And I'm sure you filed your paperwork correctly. For once."

name: Hundred Acre Wood
text:
HOME AWAY FROM HOME Characters get +1 {W} while here.
HUNNY QUEST Hunny characters get +1 {L} while here.

name: Kronk
text:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
PICKUP! Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
flavor_text: "You want that extra crispy?"

name: Mulan
text: DEMOLISH Whenever you play this or another Floodborn character, you may banish chosen item.
flavor_text: This replica is just as good in a fight as the original—no training necessary.

name: Megavolt
text: FORCE FIELD While you have no cards in your hand, this character gains Resist +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
flavor_text:
"This guy's a real live wire!"
—Launchpad

name: Mike Wazowski
text: FIND A FRIEND When you play this character and whenever he quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a character card, they may put it into their hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of their deck.

name: Pocahontas & Meeko
Woody & Buzz Lightyear
Sulley & Boo
text:
Combo Shift 4 {I}
THE POWER OF FRIENDSHIP When this character is banished, if any of the cards that were under them are character cards, you may play those characters from your discard for free.

name: The Madrigal Family
text:
Madrigal Shift 3 {I}
FAMILY BLESSINGS Once during your turn, whenever you remove 1 or more damage from one of your characters, put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

name: Merida
text:
FOCUSED ENERGY This character may enter play exerted to draw a card.
BECKON During your turn, whenever another character of yours enters play exerted, you may draw a card.

name: Aladdin & Genie
text:
Shift 3 {I}
SLEIGHT OF HAND When you play this character, you may put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw that number of cards plus 1.

name: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell
text:
Shift 4 {I}
YOU CAN FLY! Your characters gain Evasive.

name: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet
text:
Shift 3 {I}
MAGICAL MIX This character gets +1 {L} for each different ink type of characters you have in play.

name: Maleficent & Diablo
Tod & Copper
text:
Shift 2 {I}
Evasive

name: Carl Fredricksen & Russell
text:
Shift 4 {I}
OUTDOOR SKILLS While this character is at a location, all characters at that location get +1 {L} and gain Evasive.

name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse
text:
Duo Shift 0 {I}
THINKING OF YOU If this character would be banished, put them into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.

name: Rapunzel & Flynn Rider
Meilin Lee
text:
Temporary Shift 3 {I}
KARAOKE QUEEN Once during your turn, whenever this character sings a song, gain 3 lore.

name: Dash Parr & Violet Parr
Darkwing Duck & Launchpad
Scar
text:
VICTOR'S REWARD During your turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.
